attack_patterns: presence of suspicious or obfuscated URLs in email body
urgent or enticing subject lines related to health, finance, or job offers
misspellings, grammatical errors, and nonsensical filler text to evade detection
calls to action urging clicks or data entry
attack_sophistication_levels: basic evasion with URL obfuscation and social engineering
medium sophistication combining multiple evasion techniques
absence of advanced polymorphic or zero-day exploits
mitigation_strategies: email filtering with URL reputation analysis
content-based detection using NLP and heuristic analysis
user awareness and training on phishing indicators
machine learning classification on multi-source datasets
detection_approaches: flagging emails with multiple suspicious URLs
keyword and phrase detection combining urgency and call-to-action
gibberish or filler word detection via token analysis
subject line pattern monitoring for generic or overly promotional language
fuzzy matching for brand impersonation detection
